newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria cenbank sets repo, leaves rates steady.
newsitem.headline: Austria cenbank sets repo, leaves rates steady.

text.p: The Austrian National Bank on Thursday said it was calling for bids on one-week securities repurchase agreements at a fixed 3.0 percent, unchanged from last week, and said it had left its key interest rates steady.
Repo bids have to be in by 1200 GMT on Friday, it said.
Last week, the central bank allotted 8.74 billion schillings, or 10 percent of bids, in repos.

The Austrian discount rate remains at 2.50 percent and the Lombard emergency financing rate at 4.75 percent. The Gomex money market rate stands at 3.4 percent. -- Knut Engelmann, Vienna newsroom +431 53112-274
